text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe seems sluggish
compared to her usual self, and she
looks a little unwell, too. I
suggest
ending early...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I can't stop now... My friend is still
running...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: If she can keep going, then so can I...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I need to close the gap between us...
before our
next race... Even if it's just by
a little...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I'll be fine. I won't overdo it...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe could be pushing
herself too
hard. I think it's about time
to adjust her racing
schedule.
